name: extract_b0_masks
summary: Extracts each b0 volume from a DWI series and computes brain masks for it with DIPY median_otsu and FSL BET, plus a consensus mask.
description: For every b=0 volume (bval within 50 of zero) it saves the volume, a median_otsu brain and mask, a BET mask (-f 0.2) and their product as a consensus mask, processing volumes in parallel. Use it to compare or QC b0 brain masks across a DWI run. The script writes its files next to the input DWI rather than into the output folder.

inputs.description: DWI series with bvals; b0 volumes are identified from the bvals.

outputs.description: Extracted b0 volumes with median_otsu, BET and consensus brain masks.
